paragraphs: At Graphcore you will design production-quality test infrastructure that engineers can extend, maintain and rely on as Graphcore’s ML software grows. You will architect scalable test frameworks and build CI/CD pipelines that run across simulators, emulators and physical hardware. This role gives you scope to shape software architecture and developer experience, not merely add tests to existing systems, allowing you to influence how the ML stack is validated from frameworks to AI accelerator hardware.

I have a strong focus on testing, having applied systematic evaluation to verify complex data pipelines and ensure correctness. In another project I combined omics and graph techniques to analyse large‑scale biological datasets, achieving consistent performance across thousands of cell lines and genes while maintaining tight resource utilisation. Both experiences demonstrate my ability to construct reliable, reproducible test suites that surface issues early and provide clear evidence of numerical accuracy, directly aligning with Graphcore’s need for rigorous ML stack validation.

I bring proven production expertise, having built end‑to‑end fintech APIs that operate reliably under heavy load and integrate seamlessly with existing services. Additionally, I containerised critical workloads using Docker, deployed them on AWS Lambda and managed access through IAM policies, ensuring secure, scalable execution in cloud environments. These capabilities equip me to deliver the production‑grade software Graphcore requires for its ML QA pipelines, supporting continuous integration and automated testing across diverse hardware targets.
